subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw solve the stranded `message_tool_only` final issue with this PR’s default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` config, or with the newer default-recovery/no-new-config direction after #99536 is refreshed?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same message-loss class but make different config and privacy-boundary choices, and the claimed successor is currently conflicting rather than a safe replacement.
